title: Signal & Intent Routing
tagline: Turn buying signals into the right rep's Slack in minutes: account-level website reveal with privacy gates, time-decayed intent scores with surge detection, and first-match routing with round-robin and dedupe.
why: Buyers research long before they fill a form. The team that sees the signal first and routes it to one accountable owner with context wins the meeting. Most stacks fail in the plumbing: duplicate webhooks, alerts to the wrong rep, residential IPs matched to companies, stale signals treated as hot. This repo is that plumbing, with the privacy rules built in.
covers: IPv4 CIDR matching, most-specific prefix wins; ISP / residential / VPN ranges are never matched to a company
Consent gate: visits without analytics consent are dropped before matching; output is account-level only, no person data
Intent scoring: per-signal weights, exponential decay with a half-life, 7-day surge vs 4-week baseline, route / nurture / ignore trigger
Routing: rule conditions (eq, neq, in, gte, lte, contains), first match wins, account-owner override, round-robin pools, event-id dedupe, fallback queue
Slack-style alert payload with account, signal, page, score, owner and SLA
gaps: No Clearbit / 6sense / Bombora connection: IP ranges and signals are synthetic JSON
Builds the Slack payload but does not post it, and does not verify webhook signatures

ops.label: Account reveal
ops.help: Match consented visits to companies by IP range. ISP and residential ranges are excluded. All IPs are from documentation ranges.

ops.label: Intent scores
ops.help: Score accounts from weighted signals that decay over time, and flag accounts surging against their own baseline.

ops.label: Route to Slack
ops.help: Dedupe events, apply the first matching rule, assign an owner (account owner first, then round-robin) and build the Slack alert.
